messages:
emma: quick question — our sample-app's streaming client treats 202/202 from the hosted API as success but the SDK surfaces an 'UnknownError' with no retry_hint. that's causing confusion when a partial stream ends early.

raj: can't reproduce locally, can you paste the raw response? :mag:

emma: here's the gist from prod logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Content-Type: text/event-stream
X-Redwood-Request-Id: r-abc123

:stream closed after 120s
```
SDK: Error("Unrecognized response status: 202")

lina: this screams mismatch between transport handling and our error mapping. streaming endpoints should map 202 -> ephemeral-success with a "partial" flag not an error. also include retryable=false.

noah: agreed. also for gRPC we map to OK with metadata; we need parity across REST/gRPC/WS. right now some SDKs throw typed exceptions (e.g., StreamingError) while others just raise generic RuntimeError.

jun: proposal: normalize error envelope to {code, class, message, retryable, hint_url}. keep code as enum like MODEL_NOT_FOUND | RATE_LIMIT | TRANSIENT_SERVER_ERROR | PARTIAL_STREAM_END. then SDKs unwrap into typed exceptions that carry the same attributes. docs link: https://redwood.dev/docs/errors

emma: love that. small UX ask though — add human-friendly message in root exception for onboarding: e.g., "Partial stream: the model ended early. Not retryable — check prompt length or model timeout." and include how-to in hint_url.

sdk-bot: New issue created: DEVEX-1429 - "Normalize streaming status mapping & typed exceptions across SDKs" assigned to @lina :white_check_mark:

raj: implementation note: server currently returns 202 for accepted async jobs and 204 for no-content; we should avoid overloading 202 for streaming end. maybe return 200 + {status:"partial"} for SSE. need infra sign-off.

lina: I'll draft a small compatibility shim in py-sdk that converts 202->PartialStreamException with fields code=PARTIAL_STREAM_END, retryable=false, hint_url.

noah: let's also add unit test showing backward compatibility: older clients should still see a string error but new clients get typed exception.

emma: thank you. can we add a quick sample in the onboarding sample-app to show catching typed exceptions?

jun: will add a snippet to sample-apps/streaming-handling with code:
```
try:
    stream = client.stream_generate(prompts)
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk)
except PartialStreamException as e:
    print("partial stream", e.code, e.hint_url)
    # fall back to sync retry or small prompt tweak
```

emma: perfect :tada:

lina: I'll follow up with PR and link here when ready.
